morning.caption:
One event, five steps to your wallet. The IEA says oil supply now tops demand, US crude closed at its lowest since August 28, and the gas average is $3.81, down about 54 cents since mid October. Markets still price 91% odds of a Fed hike December 9 (market odds). What it means for you at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
Gas is down, but markets still price about 91% odds of a quarter point Fed hike on December 9 (CME FedWatch, market odds). Credit cards and HELOCs move with the Fed almost one for one. Mortgages follow the 10 year Treasury, near 5.1%. Savers gain a little. Full breakdown at fiopoin.com. General information, not financial advice.

evening.caption:
Iran's navy says a fourth tanker hit a mine near Hormuz, yet Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44 on Monday. The reason: Gulf exports recovered faster than demand. Diesel dipped below $6 for the first time since September, which eases freight costs with a lag. Our read, labeled as judgment: pump prices drift lower unless shipping is hit hard. More at fiopoin.com.
